lines.text: I want you to notice me in a corner cafe
at the Harbor of the Heavens, wandering in thought,
discovering water on Jupiter's moons,
healing the sick with silent prayers
and molding a better world to return to
with every pulsing beat after walking alone.
I want you to really notice me
with the distances we couldn't avoid
and our younger selves watching and dreaming,
while our elders clutch their pearls,
hold their faith and breath closely,
freeing their worries peacefully.
I've journeyed beyond any place you can conceivably be.
So I thought, life has burned all of my love stories.
All ends led to losses,
victory-less seasons for a man that wanted just one win.
I could celebrate forever.
Ice has frozen in thought,
friendships in death and departure.
I've learned to love myself more,
manage loss and harvest a wizardry more brilliant
than the scarlet poppies and purple blossoms
at time and tears have just claimed.
Yet from a distant window, beautiful and calm,
hope tells me you'll see me.
And if you notice me and capture my eyes
as you refocus yours,
stepping back and letting them say hello,
all the fatigue of wandering alone in thought,
in windless seasons and scarlet poppies
won't prevent me from sharing a smile
worth the promise of my heart.

scenes.lines: I'd want you to notice me. / in a corner cafe— / at the harbor / of the heavens / wandering in thoughts ... (Find me at the harbor, at the small tables, watching.)
scenes.treatment: Daytime/sunlight. POET wanders from new temple around harbor to café. At the café, POET observes romantic interests at other tables.

POET lowers himself onto the third chair and sits watching: his head keeps going out to the water and to the couples at the other tables

bodies.action: leans across her table toward her partner

scenes.lines: discovering / water / on Jupiter's moons— ... (The couples orbit each other the way Jupiter keeps its moons — close, and counted.)
scenes.treatment: B-Roll Inspos: Couple at the water on Jupiter's moon. People walking together on a harbor.

bodies.action: circles her partner slowly, arms reaching

shots.action: B-roll: a couple at the water's edge, holding both hands, turning close; above them the moons come out one at a time

bodies.action: prays, holding the rosary close, bowing

shots.action: the love stories burn: five letters on the quay stones catch one after another; sparks rise

bodies.action: grips a purple blossom stem, armful held to his chest

shots.action: the becoming: he stops in the cut ground, opens his arms, and the armful empties into him as poppies and blossoms flower out along his arms and shoulders

characters.name: POET
characters.who: THE POET, a man: a Black man in his thirties, dark brown skin, short faded haircut, full well-groomed beard, as in the reference photos. He is the speaker of every poem.

characters.name: BROTHER, FRIENDS, ELDERS, COUPLES
characters.who: THE FAMILY AND FRIENDS of the later poems: the brother and friends at the reunion (12), the remembered elders (12), the elders at prayer and the couples of 13, everyday people (14).

characters.name: YOUNG POET
characters.who: THE YOUNG POET, the poet at six: a small Black boy, dark brown skin, short hair, big watchful eyes; child proportions (a larger head, short limbs). He grows into the poet (panel B describes him in words only).

characters.name: THE WOMAN (was "the poet" puppet)
characters.who: THE WOMAN, the puppet the arena used to call 'the poet' (renamed: the poet is now the man). A Black woman, dark brown skin, a full rounded afro, eyes OPEN. In the poems she plays the women: the MOTHER (09), SHE in the far window (13).

passage.line: Yet from a distant window, beautiful and calm,
passage.why_fulcrum: The 'Yet' turns the catalogue of losses back to hope of being seen; it makes the next scene (14, taken by the haze, 'Don't make me leave') a leaving of hope just found.

answer.title: Far Speaking
answer.said: Why, we may even talk with distant cities.
answer.why: His 'distant window' meets the archive's 'distant cities': the old promise that distance can be spoken across, which is exactly his hope.

passage.gesture_detail: Right palm flat on the cafe window glass, fingers spread, laid just before the line and held through the answer.
passage.surface: a single lit window across the lagoon, far side of the water; its reflection repeats the picture on the surface

plate.why: Mirror Thread Bay: lagoon, boardwalks, flooded rooms, handprints on glass; the harbor cafe and a distant window across water both plausibly exist.

passage.staging: Camera behind his shoulder through the cafe glass; he faces a far lit window across the water; archive opens in that window and trembles in its reflection.
